q.line: Southern winds, scattered clouds from the cove
stanza: We tell tales to be known
Or be spared the sorrow
You're so fair to behold
What will be left when you're gone?
And it shakes everything you know
How we were when the waters were low
Southern winds, scattered clouds from the cove
And, oh, oh, oh, oh, spare me the glow

partner.line: How we were when the waters were low

q.line: Last night, my brother, he got drunk and drove
stanza: Last night, my brother, he got drunk and drove
And this cop, he pulled him off to the side of the road
And he said, "Officer, officer, you got the wrong man
No, no, I'm a student of medicine, a son of a banker, you don't understand"
The cop said, "No one got hurt, you should be thankful
And your carelessness, it is something awful
And no, I can't just let you go
And though your father's name is known
Your decisions now are yours alone
You're nothing but a stepping stone
On a path
To debt, to loss, to shame"

partner.line: And this cop, he pulled him off to the side of the road

q.line: But I want that Rolls-Royce that the homie Lennon drove
q.linePrev: Money kills, that's the truth, it's called the root of evil
q.lineNext: So, if you don't talk about some money, I'ma send you home

partner.line: So, if you don't talk about some money, I'ma send you home

q.line: Black road long and I drove and drove
stanza: Black road long and I drove and drove
And came upon a crossroad
The night was hot and black
I see Robert Johnson with a 10-dollar guitar
Strapped to his back looking for a tune
Ah, well here comes Lucifer with his canon law
And a hundred black babies running from his genocidal jaw
He got the real killer groove
Robert Johnson and the devil, man
Don't know who is gonna rip off who
Circle ghost with me
Above the cyprus grove
Steady now
Still a long way from home
The world does have to go in pain
Oh steady now
Everything in it's place
Steady now

partner.line: Still a long way from home

q.line: It was all silent except the sound of one crow following us as we wove through…
stanza: In the middle of November we went back into the woods right after breakfast to…
At the barricade, I stood listening
In my backpack you were sleeping with her hat pulled low
All the usual birds were gone or freezing
It was all silent except the sound of one crow following us as we wove through…
I walked and you bobbed and dozed, sweet kid
We were watched and followed and I thought of Geneviève
Sweet kid, I heard you murmur in your sleep
"Crow," you said
"Crow," and I asked
"Are you dreaming about a crow?"
And there she was

partner.line: In my backpack you were sleeping with her hat pulled low

And I must push my barrow all the day
And I must push my barrow all the day

One little hut among the bushes
One that I love
Still sadly to my memory rushes
No matter where I rove
When will I see the bees a humming

q.line: Mama, leave the food on the stove
stanza: Every inch of road's got a town
Daddy, how come you're never around?
I miss you, like everything now
Mama, leave the food on the stove
Leave your car in the middle of the road
This happy family with everything now
We turn the speakers up 'til they break
'Cause every time you smile, it's a fake

q.line: Maybe a woman at a stove
stanza: And if I were a drone
Patrolling foreign skies
With my electronic eyes for guidance
And the element of surprise
I would be afraid
To find someone home
Maybe a woman at a stove
Baking bread, making rice
Or just boiling down some bones
If I were a drone
